_comment: Every pnpm audit exception (ignoreGhsas in pnpm-workspace.yaml) must be listed here with a review date.

exceptions.scope: build-time only (astro check, unstorage, eslint globbing)
exceptions.reason: Build-time only (astro check / unstorage / eslint globbing), never ships to the live site, no untrusted input; recheck 2026-12-01. No patched version as of 2026-11-17. The time-boxed audit-ignore decision record has the details.
